title: RossFast production host and explicit user selection binding

reconcile.requested_goal: Make the already qualified restricted RossFast path usable from normal SWAP5 application execution through explicit user selection without changing RossFast science or transaction semantics.

current_architecture_evidence.interpretation: Current Status-A architecture admits runtime/transaction, persistence, serialized MultiSWAP and bounded adapters, but does not establish a broad stable public application API or generic top-level application host.

historical_rossfast_k_runtime_evidence.reused_rule: Do not hard-code RossFast policy into the generic canonical runtime; model-owned selection may specialize only through a qualified generic seam.

why_material: A RossFast-only top-level host would duplicate application ownership rather than bind to an existing authority.
It would force F-ROSS12 to invent default Reference routing, application lifecycle and user-selection ownership that currently belong to no admitted generic host contract.
That would silently turn a bounded RossFast wiring task into API/application-architecture design.
It would make later Reference/RossFast host convergence harder and could create two competing production entrypoints.

qualification.reason_not_started: There is no valid production candidate to qualify until the missing generic application-host prerequisite exists. Existing F-CI80/F-CI81/F-CI91 RossFast evidence remains valid and is not rerun.

minimum_prerequisite_capability.scope: Create one generic typed application-host decision surface for soil-water model selection and lifecycle ownership, preserving Reference as the default, without introducing broad public API or IO redesign.
minimum_contract: One authoritative application-level soil-water model selection owner.
Reference is the default when no alternative is explicitly selected.
Alternative model selection is explicit and typed, never inferred silently.
Host owns routing/lifecycle only and does not own solver science or transaction acceptance semantics.
Unsupported model kinds fail closed before physical state mutation.
No legacy .swp grammar change is required by the host contract itself.
No broad stable public API claim is made.
Existing Reference execution remains behaviorally unchanged.
The seam must permit a later F-ROSS12 binding to delegate RossFast execution to the already qualified F-ROSS11 composition rather than duplicate it.

f_ross12_resume_condition: Resume F-ROSS12 only after the generic minimal application-host contract has an admitted production authority and exact current-canonical dependency identity is rechecked.
explicit_exclusions: root or general source-sink RossFast support
arbitrary heterogeneous-profile or grid RossFast support
mutations: Governance checkpoint only on F-ROSS12 owner branch.
No production source, scientific equation, table asset, Reference backend, transaction policy, API, IO grammar or canonical branch changed.
next_permitted_action: Live-check for an existing equivalent project-wide minimal application-host workunit. If none exists, open a separate bounded generic host-contract capability. Do not implement RossFast-specific production host wiring until that prerequisite is admitted.
